name: The Sword of the Ancestors
description: A legendary dwarven blade was lost when the Flooded Mine was abandoned. It must be recovered to restore the honor of your clan, but you'll need the right tools and connections to reach the lowest depths.

start_condition.start_hint: Speak with Thistle Goldworthy at the Wayward Wagon.

requirements.description: This is a matter of dwarven honor.

stages.description: Thistle saw kobolds carrying a rusted but ornate dwarven hilt up into the Cragspire Mountains.

objectives.description: Search the mountain pass for kobold tracks.

stages.description: Kobold tracks lead into the Flooded Mine, but the lowest level is barred by a rusted iron grate. You'll need a crowbar (most general stores sell them).

objectives.description: Obtain a Heavy Crowbar (Can be bought or found).

stages.description: Use the crowbar to bypass the grate and enter the lowest mining shafts.

objectives.description: Reach the Kobold Warrens in the mine.

stages.description: Clear the kobolds defending the stolen blade.

objectives.description: Defeat the shaman guarding the hilt.

stages.description: Retrieve the Ancestral Blade. It's partially embedded in a geode.
Perform the ritual of clan restoration at the Dwarven Geode Cache.

objectives.description: Lay the blade in the geode cache.

offer.text: Did I? Oh, I did. Last week on the Cragspire pass, a whole column of the little horrors, and two of them carrying a sword between them like a dead hog. Big, old, dwarf-made, all runes and rust. You've got that look, friend. Like I just told you where your grandmother's buried.

where.label: Where did they take it?
where.text: Up the pass, toward the old mine with the pulley over the shaft. Nobody's worked it since it flooded. Kobolds love a hole in the ground.

accept.label: That blade belongs to my clan. I'll get it back.
accept.text: Thought you might say that. If they've gone deep, you'll want a crowbar: those old mines have grates on the lower levels. I'd sell you one, but I'm out. Try any general store.

decline.label: Not now.
decline.text: It's been rusting a hundred years. It'll keep a little longer.

crowbar.label: I need a crowbar.
crowbar.text: Any general store. Ironpeak's mining supplier, if you want a good one.

grate.label: I'm through the grate.
grate.text: Then mind the scaffolding. Kobolds build it, and kobolds are not engineers.

kobolds.label: The kobolds have a whole warren down there.
kobolds.text: Kill the one with the bones in its hair first. Trust me.

back-to-it.label: I'll get it.
back-to-it.text: Bring it past the wagon after. I want to see.

after.text: Look at that. Not a speck of rust. I could get you a fortune for it in Goldenhaven. No? No. Of course not. Wear it well.
